categories.title: Breakouts
categories.description: Getting the puck out of the defensive zone under different forechecks.

plays.title: Up the wall
plays.when: Wall open, F1 on the D. The default first option.

plays.title: Up to low centre
plays.when: F2 sits on our wall winger. Short middle outlet to the swinging centre.

plays.title: Over (D-to-D)
plays.when: Strong side flooded. Change sides behind the net and go up the far wall.

plays.title: Wheel
plays.when: D1 has speed and no pressure low. Carry behind the net, D2 is the pick.

plays.title: Reverse
plays.when: F1 follows the wheel tight. Bank it off the end boards back to D2.

plays.title: Rim up the wall
plays.when: No time for a clean pass. Rim it, the winger bumps to the centre.

plays.title: Stretch
plays.when: Two forecheckers deep. Over, then a long pass to the flying weak-side wing.

plays.title: Five-man exit
plays.when: Controlled exit with numbers. Centre through the middle, D1 jumps up.
